name: MediaStack
description: Multi-user blogging platform where creators can publish, manage, and edit content from a personal dashboard with role-based authentication and scalable REST API architecture.
problem: Content creators often deal with cumbersome CMS tools that lack fast live previews, clean dashboard statistics, and straightforward role authorization.
solution: Built a high-performance MERN blogging application featuring JWT authentication, rich text publishing capabilities, and an optimized RESTful API design.
features: Interactive creator dashboard for article publishing and editing
Responsive glassmorphism UI built with React and Tailwind CSS
architecture: Client-Server architecture with React frontend communicating with Node.js/Express REST API endpoints, backed by MongoDB Mongoose schemas.
metrics: Sub-100ms API responses and clean modular state management across dynamic routes.

name: Backend-Ledger
description: Secure backend ledger system for managing transactions, user accounts, and financial records following MVC architecture and strict security controls.
problem: Handling digital ledger entries requires zero data loss, strict transactional boundaries, and multi-step input validation to prevent unauthorized record manipulation.
solution: Designed a robust Node.js and Express backend implementing password hashing, structured error handling, JWT payload validation, and MongoDB atomic updates.
features: JWT payload encryption and role-based route middleware
Comprehensive request payload validation and error logging
Modular MVC code layout for scalable maintainability
architecture: MVC backend structure built on Express.js with custom validation middleware, MongoDB database connection, and JSON response normalization.
metrics: 100% data verification compliance across simulated high-concurrency transaction bursts.

name: SmailyZo – AI Appointment System
tagline: AI Voice & Chat Booking Engine for Dental Clinics
description: AI-powered appointment booking system for dental clinics featuring real-time conversational voice handling with Vapi AI and automated scheduling workflows via n8n.
problem: Dental clinics lose inquiries during off-hours or busy front-desk hours, resulting in missed appointments and slow patient follow-ups.
solution: Created an automated AI agent system combining Vapi voice AI and n8n webhooks to qualify patient requests, parse appointment details, and update clinic calendars instantly.
features: Conversational voice AI agent powered by Vapi
n8n automated workflow engine for calendar & CRM logging
Real-time patient qualification and transcript recording
React dashboard for appointment overview and agent analytics
architecture: Vapi AI Voice Pipeline triggering n8n Webhook workflows, which process patient intents and communicate with a React dashboard.
metrics: 80%+ reduction in manual booking response times for clinical trial workflows.

name: Atomic AI
description: An AI-powered full-stack application demonstrating Groq API integrations, RAG architecture, and intelligent workflow automation in a scalable MERN environment.
problem: Complex user queries required fast context retrieval, multi-turn state preservation, and reliable AI response synthesis.
solution: Engineered a high-performance full-stack web application integrating Groq LLM endpoints, vector-based RAG pipeline, and a responsive React UI.
features: Groq API integration for sub-second LLM inference
RAG context retrieval pipeline for verified knowledge answering
Interactive React interface with live response streaming
Node.js backend proxy with rate-limiting and prompt security
architecture: MERN Stack connected to Groq Cloud LLM API and RAG vector store for instant, context-aware responses.
metrics: Sub-second AI response latency with seamless full-stack state synchronization.

name: Goldman Sachs Cybersecurity

problem: Modern enterprise applications face complex cybersecurity threats requiring rigorous encryption standards and vulnerability prevention.

features: Password cracking simulation and strength analysis
Implementation of cryptographic primitives in Java
Vulnerability assessment reports for enterprise architecture
architecture: Java cryptographic module execution simulating multi-factor authentication and secure data transmission.
metrics: Completed simulation modules certified by Goldman Sachs software security engineering track.
